Scope.MeasurementScope: All five Game profiles replay the same authoritative entity, recipient, mutation, movement, login/re-entry, and traffic trace. Measurements cover the profile semantic core and a payload-derived synthesized client/proof boundary. Every post-warmup tick is timed in a fresh adapter; trace preparation, semantic oracle verification, diagnostics, and cold snapshots run in a separate evidence replay outside the timer. The secure Network transport is held constant but is not included in the timed core figures.
Scope.SharedTraceContract: Release; 120 trace ticks; 30 warmup ticks; 90 measured ticks per profile; designated primary event ticks are reported separately; application proof is immediate after each encoded delivery; public/private/Event/Control traffic counts are identical in every profile row. Payload counters use canonical Game codec sizes and count each semantic delivery once; transport framing/security are excluded.
Scope.SelectionPolicy: Scale mode measures the Game replication core and canonical Game-message bytes. It excludes sockets, security, packetization, and client engine/world storage; historical full-network V2/V3 timings are contextual controls, not ratio denominators.
